**Implementation note:** quant-trading's 'MACD oscillator' is a short/long SMA crossover (research code); the wired Q1 regime is EMA-MACD.

## Description

Go long when a short moving average crosses above a long moving average; exit or reverse when it crosses down.

## Where it may fit

Sustained directional markets; tends to whipsaw when prices oscillate around the averages.

## Vehicles

Equity/sector ETFs, stocks, futures, FX, crypto; long-only or long-short mandates.

## Required data

Adjusted close or OHLCV bars; enough history for both windows; dividends/splits; realistic fees and slippage.

## Caveats

Lagging signal; window choices can overfit. The Zipline tutorial itself calls the classic example instructional rather than a finished edge.
